source.title: Intel cuts more jobs as CEO Lip-Bu Tan's efficiency push continues
source.evidence_read: Full article retrieved and read from /tmp/nov18-consumer/a3.html and a3.txt

verified_facts: Intel confirmed another round of job reductions as its restructuring continues.
Employees reported layoffs affecting Intel's global IT workforce.
Intel did not identify the teams involved or disclose the number of employees affected.
The layoffs are part of CEO Lip-Bu Tan's drive for a more focused and efficient company.
source_quote: As part of our broader strategy to become a more focused and efficient company, we continually assess our workforce to ensure priorities and resources are appropriately aligned.
required_visible_qualification: Number of affected jobs not disclosed.
omitted_to_prevent_misinterpretation: September headcount of 81,100 is not this round's layoff count.
The difference from 85,100 at year-end 2025 is not this round's layoff count.
The source does not establish AI as the cause of these layoffs.
source_chart: No original chart required for this company layoffs article.
